meta.name: service-implementation
meta.description: Implement a specific service, module, feature slice, bug fix, migration step, or bounded-context task after requirements, architecture, contracts, file ownership, validation pack, and documentation expectations are clear. Use for coding work where the agent owns a defined path or component and must preserve surrounding behavior, tests, data safety, and project memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按既定规格实现指定代码模块或修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你要在清晰需求下编写并交付特定的组件或修复。
copy.tagline_en: Implement specified code modules or fixes per clear specs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to code a defined component or fix under clear requirements.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你布置的任务动手改代码:先读需求和周边代码,用最小改动、沿用现有风格实现;随后跑验证、补测试、更新文档,最后汇报变更、证据和风险。不会悄悄扩大改动或重写能用的代码。
howto.when: 当需求、架构、契约等前提都已明确,你让 Claude 实现具体服务、修缺陷或做迁移等代码任务时触发。

say.text: 请实现订单服务的创建接口,最小改动,沿用现有代码风格,先跑失败的测试。
修复支付模块的并发问题,保证数据安全,别改无关代码,并补充测试。
执行这次数据库迁移,更新文档和 Obsidian 笔记,运行验证命令。
say.note: Claude 会完成迁移并更新文档,汇报验证证据。

howto.what_en: Claude performs the assigned code work: reads requirements and nearby code, makes the smallest change using existing patterns, runs tests, updates docs, and reports evidence and risks without silently expanding scope.
howto.when_en: Triggers when requirements, architecture, contracts, etc. are clear and you assign a concrete code task (implement a service, fix a bug, run a migration).

say_en.text: Create order endpoint, follow existing style, minimal change, run failing tests.
say_en.note: Claude reads the code and contract, implements minimally, and validates.

say_en.text: Fix the payment concurrency bug safely, add tests, avoid unrelated changes.
say_en.note: Claude checks the TDD contract, fixes, and runs validation without scope creep.

say_en.text: Run the migration, update docs and Obsidian notes, run validation.
say_en.note: Claude performs the migration, updates docs, and reports evidence.
